Characteristics of Life
2.Living things acquire materials and energy–Living things require outside sources of energy and/or nutrients to carry on life–What is the main source of energy  for most life on Earth?–The Sun–Organisms are able to perform chemical reactions to metabolize energy–Ex include Photosynthesis or cellular respiration–Will discuss in more detail in future units
explanation: This slide discusses the second characteristic of life: living things acquire materials and energy. To carry on life, organisms require outside sources of energy and nutrients. The Sun is the primary source of energy for most life on Earth. Organisms are capable of performing chemical reactions to metabolize this energy, with key examples including photosynthesis (converting light to chemical energy) and cellular respiration (releasing stored energy).
